description: The application's own commands, granted to the one origin the console is served from and to nothing else. Tauri denies every application command to remote content unless a capability names its origin (tauri 2.11.5, src/webview/mod.rs:1819-1850), so without this the seller would press a button and read a permission error. The url here must equal control_plane::DEFAULT_BASE_URL; the_capability_grants_the_origin_this_build_uses asserts it, because a cutover that moved the constant and the content-security policy and forgot this file would build clean, ship, and refuse every command at run time. These eight are granted LOCALLY as well as remotely, because `local` defaults to true and this file does not set it false. That is deliberate rather than an oversight: with TAM_CONTROL_PLANE pointing at the vite dev server the window is local content, `is_local_url` answers true, and without the local grant every command would be refused in development while working in production — the worst way round. Nothing in the marketplace login windows is granted, here or anywhere: their window label is not main.
